label: sonnet5
sourceDraft: Y hará humear a ellos el sacerdote hacia el altar; ofrenda de fuego a Jehová; culpa ella.
spanish: Y hará humear a ellos el sacerdote hacia el altar; ofrenda de fuego a Jehová; culpa él.
grammarChanges: Changed 'ella' to 'él' for h03007005008: the Hebrew pronoun הוּא is 3rd masculine singular, agreeing with masculine אָשָׁם (asham); feminine 'ella' was a gender mismatch, not a licensed choice.
readerNote: Chose masculine 'él' to agree with the Hebrew 3ms pronoun referring back to asham, even though its Spanish gloss 'culpa' is grammatically feminine.
